context.transcript:
In local news, the town council announced that they're
considering increasing the fee to drive across the Ashington
Bridge. ® The additional funds would be used to repair
roads in the area. ® The council indicated that these repairs
are necessary before the town hosts the statewide bicycle
race next May. ® Residents will be given the opportunity to
express their opinions about the proposed bridge fee during
next month's town hall meeting.

choices: An update about a building renovation project
A proposal for a fee increase
